seoTitle: Slogan and Tagline Generator from Brand and Benefit
metaDescription: Get tagline ideas from your brand name and a benefit word using common slogan patterns. Template based, free, runs in your browser.
intro: Enter a brand name and a benefit to get a list of short slogans from common patterns.
why:
Slogans repeat a handful of shapes: a promise, a contrast, a command. Seeing your words in each shape speeds up choosing a direction.

This is a template list, so most lines need rewriting. Search any line in quotes and check trademarks before use. Nothing is uploaded.
howTo: Enter the brand and a benefit noun.
Optionally add an action verb and audience.
Scan and pick a few lines.

faq.a: No, check search and trademark databases.
